commentary: The portfolio deploys a fresh cash base across 8 sectors with a deliberate tilt toward quality compounders at value: three financial-services names (ZION, AMP, RNR) benefit from the rate-elevated NIM/float environment at single-digit forward P/Es; three healthcare names (EXEL, INCY, GMED) offer GARP profiles with double-digit revenue growth well below sector-average multiples; and three technology names (NVDA, ADBE, LRCX) capture the AI infrastructure upcycle with forward multiples materially below trailing as earnings accelerate. The remaining six positions — EME, NEM, BMY, RRC, TIGO, and STZ — diversify across Industrials, Basic Materials, Healthcare income, Energy, Communication Services, and Consumer Defensive, ensuring broad macro resilience from a model that finished with the highest composite alpha scores in the universe scan.
